info.title: Paythan API
info.description:
## Paythan Backend API

Modular monolith with domain-driven design.

### Authentication
- **Signup**: Name + Email + Phone → WhatsApp OTP → Password → Account
- **Login**: Phone + Password → JWT tokens
- **Security**: Argon2 passwords, Redis OTP, token rotation, brute-force lockout

### Extensibility
OAuth (Google/Apple) and alternative OTP channels (Email/SMS) are scaffolded in `domains/auth/providers/`.

post.description: Start registration by sending a WhatsApp OTP. Requires unique email and phone. Rate limited to 5 requests per 10 minutes.
Complete registration: verify the WhatsApp OTP, set a password, and receive JWT access + refresh tokens. OTP is single-use.
Send a WhatsApp OTP to a registered phone number. Rate limited to 5 requests per 10 minutes.
Verify the WhatsApp OTP and receive JWT access + refresh tokens.
Authenticate with username and password. Account locks for 15 minutes after 5 failed attempts.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new token pair. Old refresh token is invalidated.

get.description: Returns the profile of the user identified by the Bearer access token.

post.description: Revokes the refresh token in Redis. Access token remains valid until expiry.
